svg.text: Before: Triton, 8 waves share one tile
down GEMV tile: 16 rows × 32 outputs = 2 MFMA tiles (A, B)
every wave computes A and B: 8 copies
down GEMV: 51,200 MFMAs where 6,400 are needed
Fix: FlyDSL, one wave per tile
down GEMV: 704 one-wave workgroups = 22 row tiles × 32 splits of k
no copies: a reduce kernel sums the 32 k slices
down GEMV: 6,400 MFMAs (+ 320 for the inject GEMV)
